notes: x86-64 Linux, NASM syntax, no libc: only the write and exit syscalls.
lea computes a + b modulo 2^64; the three running values live in callee-saved registers.
Division by 10 via multiplication by the reciprocal 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCD (what compilers emit).
Own 64 KiB output buffer, flushed with a retry loop for partial writes; ~8 KiB static binary.
